name: international-patient-summary-service-with-axum
description: Backend for the IPS viewer: stores HL7 FHIR International Patient Summary document Bundles in Postgres and serves them as application/fhir+json. Every /fhir route needs a Keycloak or PASETO bearer token, under one role policy, and every access is logged.
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR OGL-UK-3.0 OR CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0

API.name: POST /fhir/Bundle
API.description: store an IPS document: 201 + Location, or 422 problem with code and pointer

API.name: GET /fhir/Bundle/{id}
API.description: the stored Bundle, Cache-Control: no-store, or 404

Modules.name: auth
Modules.description: Keycloak and PASETO guards, the production refusal; src/policy.json is the access policy by role

Modules.name: ips
Modules.description: structural IPS check and refusal codes

Modules.name: Containerfile
Modules.description: the distroless image; compose.yml profile image runs it with Postgres

Modules.name: auth tests
Modules.description: tokens, policy, and the access log
